I added a flashcard page to your "Spanish verbs" note. You'll find it under the Page switch in the note. I haven't opened it on a phone, so I don't know how it looks there.

- **Flipping:** You see the Spanish verb first. Tap the card to see the English.
- **Marking cards:** Tap "I know it" or "Again". Known cards are saved in the note, so they stay known when you come back.
- **Order:** Cards you haven't marked as known come first. Once you know all 12, it shows "all done".
- **Progress:** A bar at the top shows how many you know.
- **All cards list:** A collapsible list shows every card and which ones are known. It also has a "Start over" button that clears your known cards.

Your table is unchanged. If you add verbs to it, they'll show up as new cards.
